# How many places write a user-facing string that another file also writes.
#
# A caption, a status name, a button - each belongs to the type that owns the
# concept, asked for as TestStatus.getLabel() or
# TestRunConfiguration.getDisplayName(). A second file spelling it out is a
# divergence nothing fails over: both read correctly alone, and they stop
# agreeing the day one is renamed.
#
# tools/inspect.ps1 counts every place after the first, so this is "how many
# places should be asking an owner instead". inspect.yml fails when it goes up
# and says so when it goes down - update the number then, so the ratchet keeps
# its meaning.
#
# 304 when the check was written. The four report generators had already been
# fixed by then: they spelled out Passed, Failed, Blocked, Untested and Removed
# seventeen times between them, and now ask TestStatus.
#
# 278 after StatusBarShortcut gained cancel() and confirm(). Twenty-one dialogs
# declared Escape/"Cancel"/closeCancel identically and seven declared
# Enter/"Confirm"/submit, which was the largest cluster in the plugin.
#
# 262 after Priority, Group and Description started coming from
# TestEditorAttributes, which owns what a test case's fields are called.
#
# 246 after the rest followed: every caption the create dialog, the update
# dialog and the run grid share with a test case attribute now asks for it.
#
# 195 after the node names, the report headings, the two Git comparators and
# the verdict words followed the same route. Two that could not: NodeCount
# cannot ask DirectoryType for a node's name, because DirectoryType names its
# counts and the two would initialize each other.
195
